As Scope requires, commit only tests/test_seeded_phase3_27.py and leave tickets/phase3-exit/ untracked so Check can run requisition_review and record approve in tickets/phase3-continue-27/checks.json before the seeds lift.

Start from a fresh workspace. Do not rely on attempt 2's commit 80d401a8, because a failed attempt's commit is not merged state. Re-author phase3-exit and the batch test, then run Verification again before committing.
Send the final outcome JSON right after the commit and run no extra commands, so less time is spent waiting on the provider after the work is done.
